company_profile: PartnerRe is a global multi-line reinsurer whose Life & Health data science team advises insurers on mortality and morbidity risk.
title: Data Scientist
summary: Data Scientist with 8+ years of predictive modelling and data analysis across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, with an MSc in Machine Learning and AI. Builds regression and tree-based models in Python and SQL, from loan propensity with XGBoost to health-plan recommendations and SLA breach prediction with LightGBM, and turns results into clear, data-driven stories for clients and stakeholders. Much of his recent work uses large healthcare datasets. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Health Claims Risk Modelling
bullets: Built a predictive model of health-insurance claim risk and its drivers on public health survey data, comparing logistic regression baselines with LightGBM and XGBoost tree-based models.
Evaluated models with cross-validation and calibration checks, explained the main drivers through feature importance, and shared findings in a Power BI report and short written summary.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data Scientist role in Life & Health Data Science Consulting. My data science work has centred on predictive modelling, from loan propensity with XGBoost to breach prediction with LightGBM, and much of my recent career has been spent on health data. The thread is turning a messy dataset into an estimate someone can trust and act on.

PartnerRe helps insurers understand mortality and morbidity risk, where modelling has a very direct effect on people's lives. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Ireland together and settle there long term. A consulting role in Ireland would let me build both a life and a specialism in one place.

I would bring careful modelling and clear communication. I built SQL and PySpark pipelines over large healthcare datasets that cut manual reporting by 95%, and a reranker for health-plan recommendations that lifted conversion by 2%. Python is my main tool; R and survival analysis are areas I would strengthen quickly alongside your team.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Working with teachers has taught me to explain results plainly and to build for the people who will use them. I would be glad to talk further.
